cards.t: MSCI Rules Target Single-Asset Treasury Companies
cards.b: MSCI finalized rules to classify non-operating companies whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset as ineligible for index inclusion, effective November 30.

per.BTC: Potential index removal for major bitcoin treasury holders could create downward pressure.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact list of companies to be removed from the index.

cards.t: Marqeta and Coinbase Expand Stablecoin Card Partnership
cards.b: Coinbase and Marqeta extended their six-year tie-up to power stablecoin-backed debit cards, building on their previous 2020 collaboration.

per.USDC: Expanded card integration increases utility and transaction volume for USDC.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Launch dates for specific new regional card rollouts.
